metadata.title: Applying Machine Learning and SHAP Method to Identify Key Influences on Middle-School Students’ Mathematics Literacy Performance

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used a single plausible value (PV1MATH) for analysis, which does not meet the criteria for proper handling of plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Publisher full text and matching Huang PDF: survey sampling weights not specified; XGBoost algorithmic weights and WLE scores are different concepts.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not mention using multilevel modeling or any methods that account for school clustering, indicating that it likely used student-level models.
design_fields.q4_rationale: Manual publisher full-text review, §3.1 and Supplementary Table S2: XGBoost prediction performance evaluated on Hong Kong, Korea, U.S., and Spain datasets; U.S. and Spain are outside the six-system estimation sample.

design_fields.q4b_note: Manual publisher full-text review, §3.1 and Supplementary Table S2: model prediction performance compared separately for Hong Kong, Korea, United States, and Spain.
design_fields._q2_audit: Corrected after matching source text check; original rationale: The study explicitly states that it did not apply sampling weights in the analysis.
